title: Two Separate Crews
summary: Compare two independent groups with t.test(y ~ group): Welch's test, Student's test, and which group R subtracts from which.
hints: Formula first, then the data: `t.test(anxiety_post ~ group, data = survey)`. That's Welch's test.
`welch$parameter` is the df, `welch$p.value` is p, and `welch$estimate` holds the two group means.
